purpose: gnsspipe2: like gnsspipe1 (same guest guest-gnsspipe1.sh, owned-gnsspipe1.json, undo payload-gnsspipe1-undo) but the tool first sends libmnl's first DSP frame aaf0090005fe32000001003f01aa0f (recovered with the n2mnld emulator: what libmnl writes to /dev/gpsdl0 right after opening it) and then reads 20 s: captures the real DSP ROM answer that the n2mnld harness needs (M3 step 2).
